description: CONCAT is nullable on MySQL when any argument is nullable, unlike PostgreSQL where concat() ignores NULL arguments

columns.name: display
columns.note: MySQL CONCAT returns NULL if any argument is NULL, unlike PostgreSQL's concat()

name: concat_mysql_nullable
query_sql:
-- @name GetDisplayNameMysql
-- @returns :many
SELECT CONCAT(name, nickname) AS display FROM users
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, nickname VARCHAR(255));
